 'GMA' Deals & Steals for holiday gifting 
 4:42 'GMA' Deals & Steals: Holiday gift ideas Blush Camera, Pearson Farm, Softies, Wisconsin Cheeseman By Tory Johnson November 9, 2026, 4:58 AM 
 It's Tory Johnson's exclusive "GMA"   Deals   &   Steals for holiday gifting.
 You can score big savings on products from brands such as Pearson Farm, Blush Camera and more. The deals start at just $3.50 and are up to 51% off. Find all of Tory Johnson's   Deals   &   Steals   on her website,   GMADeals.com .

 50% off Pearson Farm Pearson Farm: Pecans, Baked Goods and Peach Goods
 Bring Southern flavor to holiday gatherings and gift giving. Pearson Farm is a fifth-generation family-owned and operated farm in Peach County, Georgia, that grows peaches and pecans. The natural pecan halves have a rich, buttery flavor, elevated and giftable when covered in chocolate, roasted, tossed with spices, and added to homemade cakes and pies. Choose from a big assortment including gift boxes, delicious baked goods, peach preserves and a Peach Cobbler Kit with filling and dry mix. Limit two per order. Shipping is $4.99. $8.00 - $37.50

 Valid: 11/09/2026 to 11/09/2026 
 Shop Now 50% to 51% off Blush Camera Blush Camera: Digicam and Accessories
 Get ready for your closeup. Designed for iconic selfies and aesthetic memories, Blush Digicam is the first camera with a built-in front mirror so you can always see yourself before the shot. You can even flip on the flash without taking a photo and use it as a portable compact mirror on the go. The camera is powered by SONY CMOS Sensor for high-quality, sharp photos, up to 64 Mega Pixels / 4k 32FPS Video. Electronic image stabilization technology provides clearer photos. The 4K Ultra HD 640x480 screen gives professional quality image preview. Choose from fun colors. Each camera includes an 8GB SD Card, Carry Pouch and Wrist Strap. The included 8GB SD card can store 1,200+ photos. Larger storage 64GB SD card, Protective Silicone Case with Bag Charm and Beaded Wrist Straps are also available. Shipping is $5.99 or free over $200. $19.00 - $85.00 
 $39.00 - $170.00

 Shop Now 50% off Bicycle Cards Bicycle Cards: Playing Cards
 When you think of playing cards… you think of Bicycle. Since 1885, Bicycle has been the most trusted name in playing cards, seen in the hands of world‑famous magicians, featured across movies and TV, and played on kitchen tables everywhere. Every Bicycle deck is crafted in the company's Northern Kentucky facility. Connect, compete and laugh together with Bicycle's classic cards including special licensed decks like "Peanuts," Mickey and "Bluey." The Bag Games Bundle, new this year, is a three-game bundle built for quick, family-friendly fun at home or on the go. Cats in the Corner brings solitaire-inspired strategy, Trash adds fast number-sequencing action and Hogwash delivers playful bluffing for a mix of game styles everyone can enjoy. Shipping is $4.99 or free over $40. $3.50 - $17.50

 Shop Now 50% off The Wisconsin Cheeseman The Wisconsin Cheeseman: Cheese, Meats and Snacks
 Build your best spread with Wisconsin Cheeseman, celebrating 80 years of business. Savory Assortments including sausages (Italian, Original Summer, Garlic Summer), cheeses (Sharp Cheddar, Monterey Jack, Colby, Brick and more), and sauces (Sweet Hot Mustard, Stone Ground Mustard, Spicy BBQ) paired with Meat Sticks (Beef, Honey Ham, Pork) all ready to gift and enjoy. Salted cashew and mixed nut tins create a delightful snacking experience. Finish off any gathering with delicious holiday cookies: gingerbread, chocolate sandwiches, vanilla fingers, apricot galettes, bonbon cookies and more. Cheese spreads are also available. Shipping is $4.99. $15.00 - $26.00

 Shop Now 50% off 3Doodler 3Doodler: 3D Pens
 Gift the exciting world of 3D printing with 3Doodler. The Start+ is specially designed for kids aged six and up, with an ergonomic build that fits perfectly in smaller hands, making it easy and fun to use. The Start+ is completely safe, with no hot parts, durable construction, and a simple, mess-free filament loading system. The 3Doodler Flow is a high-temperature, multispeed, variable temperature-controlled 3D pen for ages 14 and above who want to create in 3D. Make art, craft custom decor and experience a new world of drawing in 3D. Whether drawing freehand or using one of the hundreds of free online projects, this screen-free activity engages the imagination. Bring sweet ideas to life with the 3D Candy Pens that let you create real candy art you can eat. Traditional candy sculpting can be time-consuming and tricky, but the 3Doodler Chef Pen for ages 14+ and the 3Doodler Candy Pen for ages 8+ make it simple, safe, and fun for bakers big and small. Refills for printing are also available. Limit 30 per order. Shipping is $4.99. $7.50 - $50.00

 Shop Now 50% off Softies Softies: Lounge Sets
 Get that classic cable-knit look with the beloved plush, fluffy marshmallow softness of Softies. New this holiday season, cable-knit marshmallow sets keep you warm without the bulk, and the half-zip top makes it easy to warm up or cool down. The tapered pants have pockets, and the whole set looks put-together enough for holiday brunch, travel, or a morning of opening presents. It's machine-washable and comes in a beautiful palette of warm neutrals and deep winter tones. Size XS-2X/3X available. Limit six per order. Shipping is $9.99 or free with two or more sets. $89.00
